# @three-ws/x402-fetch

> Drop-in fetch wrapper that automatically pays x402 payment challenges with USDC on Base

@three-ws/x402-fetch is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/x402-fetch`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-fetch/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/x402-fetch/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/x402-fetch/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-fetch/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
